propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, and confidence level without scattering logic across the codebase
Metrics with no available data must return an Unavailable state carrying both a reason and an ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp
Source and confidence labels must ride on every metric value to enable downstream aggregation to segregate high-confidence structural series from classified/backfilled values
The is_authoritative() function must classify backfill_classified source as non-authoritative and exclude it from authoritative aggregations
Every REGISTRY entry must have a unique id, a lens, a source, and a confidence field enforced by uniqueness assertions
Adding new signals must require only registry population with no changes to the command rendering logic
